modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cobblemon: Speeds up the actual progress of PvE battles at 1x/2x/3x/4x by cutting the server's own waits, not just the animations. Each player picks their own speed here or with /battlespeed. Install it on both the server and the client.
cobblemon_battle_speed.command.invalid_l: Battle speed levels go from 1 to %s.
cobblemon_battle_speed.command.not_appli: Battle speed does not apply to your current battle.
cobblemon_battle_speed.command.no_permis: You are not allowed to change this setting.
cobblemon_battle_speed.command.reload_fa: Could not load the battle speed config, keeping the previous one: %s
cobblemon_battle_speed.command.saved: Saved the battle speed config and applied it.
cobblemon_battle_speed.command.save_fail: Could not save the battle speed config, keeping the previous one: %s
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.title: Battle Speed
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.cloth_miss: The settings screen needs Cloth Config. The /battlespeed command still works.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.not_connec: Battle speed is stored on the server. Open this screen after joining a world or server.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.server_mis: This server does not have Battle Speed installed.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.mine.level: Applies as soon as you save. In a battle, the next wait is already faster.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.mine.disab: Battle speed is turned off on this server.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.mine.no_pe: You are not allowed to change your speed on this server.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.mine.singl: This server only has one speed: %sx.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.mine.descr: Applies to your own wild and NPC battles. When spectating, the battlers' speed is used.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.server.des: These settings apply to the whole server. On save the server checks your permission again, writes config/cobblemon_battle_speed.json and applies it at once.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.server.ena: When off, every battle runs at 1x.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.server.spe: The first entry is level 1. The number of entries is the number of levels; values range from 0.1x to 20x.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.server.def: The level of players who have not picked one yet.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.server.bat: When on, the slowest pick of either side is used.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.server.mul: The speed when several players fight NPCs or wild Pokémon together.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.server.app: Each part's multiplier is applied on top of the level speed. A 1x battle always stays at 1x.
The pause the server takes after each battle message, Mega Showdown's included.
Pauses and delays inside move animations.
The client's HP bar and HUD tile slides. When off, the HUD may lag behind the battle.
The battlers' attack, hit and faint motions, and the particles and sounds timed to them. Poké Ball flights and move particles themselves keep their speed.
Applied to this part only, on top of the level speed. 1 keeps the level speed.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.server.ski: From this level up, move animations are skipped. 0 never skips.
cobblemon_battle_speed.config.server.per: Needed to change your own speed. 0 is everyone, 2 is operators.
Needed for these server settings and /battlespeed reload. Setting it to 0 lets anyone change the server settings.
